title: Built an iPad editing companion app for using Apple Pencil to fine tune masks and make adjustments using finger pinching
author: nickick_
selftext:
Quickly wanted to share a new tool I've been finding super useful, an iPad companion app for editing the masks of my character rig :)  
  
Workflow is to create a reference image of the character you want through Codex Imagegen 2.5, then ask it to make a bunch of small cutouts of the facial features with a white background, then ask Astra to place those features over the character cutout head. Then, ask Astra to create an iPad app that allows for Apple's PencilKit to directly edit those assets.

Vibe coding a useful iPad app with a few iterations on tooltip layout + making the brush editing smoother and more consistent between loads took about 6 hours, all while I was making edits to game assets, totally worth it IMO to get to finer grained edits that would be a total PITA using mouse clicks.

I've also been using Imagegen 2.5's inpainting tool with a lasso feature directly through the app, has been hit or miss but overall useful to include that as well.  
  
What also made this more convenient for me was stroing all of my assets on Cloudflare R2 with versioning and having my iOS game use asset hashes to determine what game assets to load once the client starts up. Then, connect the iPad app as well. Now, you have direct asset editing that shows up in your iOS game!
